name: bash
arguments:
{"command":"cd /workspace && python - <<'PY'
import ast
from src.component import count_powerful_integers
module = ast.parse(open('tests.py').read())
for node in ast.walk(module):
    if isinstance(node, ast.Assert):
        case = node.test
        args = [ast.literal_eval(arg) for arg in case.left.args]
        expected = ast.literal_eval(case.comparators[0])
        actual = count_powerful_integers(*args)
        print('PASS' if actual == expected else 'FAIL', args, 'actual =',actual,'expected =',expected)
PY"}
